newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares fall in a wait-and-see mood.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares fall in a wait-and-see mood.

text.p: Egyptian share prices retreated again on Tuesday as investors took a wait-and-see position, brokers said.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) said its overall index shed 4.80 points to 390.4 on less-than-usual turnover of 48.00 million pounds ($14.00 million).
"In the past two years we witnessed the same period of wait-and-see between March and April before demand starts to increase in May," said Dalia Sultan of EFG/Hermes brokerage.
"Investors may be waiting for corporate results," she added.

Suez Cement was the most active cement share with 3.24 million pounds changing hands. It ended 0.51 pounds up to 72.51. Helwan Portland Cement came second with slight difference in volume, but the share closed 0.55 pounds down at 79.45.
Millers were mixed but Central and West Delta Flour Mills, the most active share in the market, performed well, clsoing 3.05 pounds up to 107.5.
Egyptian American Bank, among the market's blue chips, shed 5.4 pounds to end at 157.6.
"Banks in general went up too much recently,"Sultan told Reuters.
Medinet Nasr Housing and Development led the housing sector in terms of volume, with shares worth 2.25 million pounds traded, but it closed 5.99 pounds down at 482.01.
The index for openly traded firms fell to 628.66 from 647.75 points on Monday and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms slipped to 263.35 points from 264.6.
Out of the 78 shares traded, 17 gained, 40 lost and 21 ended the day unchanged.
